# Lutron Smart Bridges

Read or control lights and shades on compatible Lutron Smart Bridges through Muse Home Link, using authorized HAP pairing (eight-digit setup code or previously authorized pairing keys) or independently paired LEAP (own client certificate/private key, pylutron-caseta). Any existing Apple Home setup is preserved: an existing pairing is never reset or removed, and a bridge already in Apple Home does not automatically give Muse its credentials.
